metadata.name: Host CPU at or above 90 percent
metadata.description: Fires when any CPU sample for a host reaches 0.9. Checked every minute over a 20 minute lookback, because these metrics take several minutes to arrive. 0.9 means 90 percent.

query.base: FROM metrics-system.cpu-* | STATS avg_cpu = AVG(system.cpu.total.norm.pct), max_cpu = MAX(system.cpu.total.norm.pct) BY host.name | WHERE max_cpu >= 0.9 | KEEP host.name, avg_cpu, max_cpu
